description: Price freshness (Android PriceFreshness.kt / iOS PriceFreshness.swift). Exchanges without their own time (exchangeTime null: Kraken, Gate.io, Hyperliquid, bitFlyer, Gemini bulk ...) are stamped with the fetch time, so a long-unchanged last price would look fresh. freshness: time used for age = exchangeTime if > 0, else lastUpdate. unchanged: 'price unchanged since' = priceChangedAt, only without exchangeTime, with known priceChangedAt and lastUpdate (> 0) and when now - priceChangedAt > max(1 h, outdatedAfter); else null. stale: reason the row/filter/status/widgets say 'outdated' - same rule as the alarm block: FETCH when the last successful fetch is older than staleAfter (wins), else TRADE when the exchange reports a trade time older than AlarmFreshness 2 h (strictly more), else null; never fetched (lastUpdateAge null) = null (callers treat it as 'no price yet'). Quiet pairs and live pairs without a trade for minutes are not outdated. next: new priceChangedAt after a successful fetch at time: kept when the price is equal and the old value is known (> 0), else time.

stale.name: fresh fetch, last trade 3 h ago
quiet pair: fresh fetch, last trade 1 h ago
live pair: no trade for 5 min is fine
last trade exactly 2 h ago is not yet outdated
fetch and trade too old: fetch wins

unchanged.name: no exchange time, unchanged 2 h, live (limit 2 min -> 1 h)
exactly 1 h is not yet unchanged
background 60 min: limit 3 h, 2 h is fine

next.name: same price keeps the change time
same price, unknown change time: starts now
